meta.note: Official names, descriptions and grades as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on all 55). Every guide below is written in our own words for this entry and names its sources; where the cited guides had not yet pinned a detail down by 18 Nov 2026, the guide says so instead of guessing.
meta.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Tracker — Leonida Legend

trophies.guide: There is no separate task here: the platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Work through the roadmap in order — story, strangers, activities, collectibles, open-world chaos, then the 100% checklist — and this one closes the set. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours to the platinum, with a single playthrough enough.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of Chapter 1. PowerPyx lists it as an automatic story trophy that cannot be missed, so just play through the opening and it unlocks at the mission's end.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: it is awarded for finishing the opening mission.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end; the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Before you finish the chapter, meditate at Jason's house — PowerPyx flags that first meditation as the game's only missable moment, and it feeds the Positive Mental Attitude trophy. There is no mission replay, so anything tied to a chapter must be done while you are in it.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: it is awarded for finishing Chapter 1. But do the Chapter 1 meditation first — see Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2; the trophy unlocks when the chapter ends. Like the other chapter trophies it is automatic — there is nothing extra to do beyond completing the story missions in order.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: it is awarded for finishing Chapter 2.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 in full; the trophy is awarded at the chapter's close. While you play through it, keep an eye on the mission-specific trophies in this guide — Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory each unlock by finishing their named mission.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: it is awarded for finishing Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 and the trophy unlocks at its end. By this point you should also be collecting the side content that feeds the later roadmap stages — stranger strands, activities and collectibles — since free roam continues after the story but there is no mission replay.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: it is awarded for finishing Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the game's final mission and this gold trophy unlocks with the credits. It is the last story trophy; after it, free roam stays open, so everything that is not story-locked can still be chased. Keep cheats off for the whole run — PowerPyx notes cheats disable trophies and saving.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: it is awarded for finishing the final mission.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. Like every mission trophy it unlocks automatically at the mission's end, so there is no extra objective — just complete the mission when the story brings it to you.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: it is awarded for finishing the named mission.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks automatically when the heist is done — no side objective is needed, just see the mission through to its end.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: it is awarded for finishing the named mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. The trophy is automatic at the mission's end, so play the mission normally and it will unlock.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: it is awarded for finishing the named mission.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. The trophy unlocks automatically when the mission ends — no extra objective is attached to it.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: it is awarded for finishing the named mission.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. It is an automatic mission trophy: complete the mission and it unlocks at the end.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: it is awarded for finishing the named mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The trophy unlocks automatically at the mission's end, like the other named-mission trophies.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: it is awarded for finishing the named mission.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: This is the hardest trophy in the set, and the last one before the platinum. PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy but notes the thresholds are lenient: the 100% checklist is closer to 60% of true completion, and most of it comes from doing the other trophies. Its roadmap step needs the checklist finished after the story, including 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars. Save it for last — nearly every other trophy feeds it.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: the 100% checklist stays available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts out of 397 in total, across four categories — PowerPyx counts 130 stunt jumps and 202 under-the-bridge flights among them. Work through them while exploring Leonida rather than grinding them in one sitting, and note the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: stunts stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type the game offers at least once — races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, the shooting range, drone races and the rest. You do not need to win or master any of them; one try of each type is enough, and the game tracks which types you have tried. Do this early so you learn which activities you enjoy before grinding their dedicated trophies.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: every activity type stays available in free roam.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Treat each challenge as a short accuracy drill: learn its target pattern first with a slow run, then push for the gold time or score. The range is repeatable without limit, so replay any challenge you miss gold on until it clicks.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: the Shooting Range stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's corners before racing it flat out — a clean line beats raw speed on a drone course, and one win per location is all the trophy asks. Tick locations off in this tracker as you win them.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: drone races stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the count is distinct races, so repeating the same one does not help. Work through the race list across Leonida's districts, varying vehicle classes so you are not stuck on one type, and use the tracker's checklist to avoid re-running a race you have already won.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: races stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and out-fish him. Fishing challenges are won on patience and timing rather than gear: watch the line, strike when the fish bites, and keep steady pressure so the line never snaps. If you lose, challenge him again — the contest is repeatable.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: fishing challenges stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play any arcade game through to its end. Pick the shortest cabinet you find first — the trophy asks for one completed game, not a high score — and save the score-chasing for after it pops.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: arcade games stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Stranger strands unlock as you explore Leonida, so keep visiting Andy's marker whenever it appears and play each mission in order until the strand closes.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: stranger strands stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's strand to its final mission and complete it. Like the other contact strands, it is a chain of missions: follow Kenton's markers across Leonida and the strand ends with this trophy.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: stranger strands stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand with its final mission. Work through Billy's missions in order whenever his marker appears; the trophy unlocks when the strand's last mission is complete.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: stranger strands stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — the five named contacts (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone) plus three more strangers you meet while exploring. Strands appear as markers on the map; finish one strand fully before moving on, and this silver trophy unlocks when your eighth strand closes.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: stranger strands stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's strand to its final mission and complete it. Follow Randy's markers and finish each mission in the chain; the trophy unlocks at the strand's end.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: stranger strands stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand with its final mission. Work through Tyrone's missions in order; the trophy unlocks when the last one is done.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: stranger strands stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Do the first one — at Jason's house — before you finish Chapter 1, because there is no mission replay and it is the only missable moment in the game (PowerPyx, GTABase). Then work through the remaining 17 spots in free roam. If you already passed Chapter 1 without it, the trophy is lost for this playthrough.
trophies.missableNote: MISSABLE — the only one: the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, can be missed, and there is no mission replay (PowerPyx, GTABase). Do it before finishing Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track down the unique animal Bret asks you to hunt and take it down. Unique animals are one-of-a-kind encounters, so follow Bret's clues to the right area, move quietly, and take the shot when you have a clear line — a spooked animal may be hard to find again.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Bret's hunt stays available in free roam.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets by finding cards scattered across Leonida. Cards are a pure collectible hunt: sweep each district methodically and tick sets off as you finish them. You only need 3 sets, not every card in the game, so focus on the sets whose cards you keep finding.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: cards stay collectible in free roam.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It action at 100 different locations across Leonida. This is a volume collectible: the counter is locations, so keep moving — revisiting the same spot adds nothing. Fold it into your exploration for The Goodtime State and you will pass 100 without a dedicated grind.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: WAiNK It locations stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges overlap heavily with the other trophies — stunts, races, hunting and combat all count — so play naturally and this one will land on its own. Note the 100% checklist wants 70 of 80 challenges, so keep completing them past 50 if you are chasing A Long Road (PowerPyx).
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: challenges stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Pick a quiet stretch of road away from police stations, break line of sight, and stay hidden until the stars clear — your partner must still be with you when the heat dies down.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: wanted levels can be built at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not let the stars clear between robberies. Plan a route of three nearby shops, hit them fast one after another, and keep moving so the police never catch up between stops.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: shop robberies can be done at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida — driving or scanning a new model adds it to the count. Explore new districts and vehicle types instead of sticking to one area; note the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so discovering vehicles feeds A Long Road too (PowerPyx).
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: vehicles stay discoverable in free roam.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends. Set it up where enemies cluster — a gang hideout or a police response — and trigger it only once you have five targets in view, so you are not left hunting for the last one as the focus runs out.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Combat Focus can be used at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — the description points at taking off without following the airport's script, so grab a plane and get airborne on your own terms. Expect a wanted response the moment you do it, so have an escape route planned before you roll onto the runway.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: VCIA stays accessible in free roam.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get hold of a Rhino tank and put it to use — the trophy's joke title points at the military tank itself. Stealing one draws a heavy police response (a video guide shows a 3-star wanted level on the theft), so plan your getaway first: take the tank somewhere open, do what you need, then ditch it before the response closes in.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Rhinos can be taken at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — this one is about stealth, not speed. Case the store first, go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so back out and try again rather than shooting your way out.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: jewelry stores can be robbed again in free roam.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Vaults are the biggest robberies in the game, so plan each hit: scout the bank, bring a fast getaway car, and do not linger once the vault is open. Five successful escapes earn the silver — the count is vaults robbed and escaped from, so a busted job does not count.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: bank vaults can be robbed again in free roam.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take its cargo and escape. Trucks follow set routes, so watch for one, block it, crack it open fast and get clear before the police response arrives — the escape matters as much as the robbery.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: armored trucks keep running their routes in free roam.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida. This is the exploration trophy: drive, fly and walk into every named area on the map until the counter fills. Pair it with the WAiNK It locations and the meditation spots, since the same sweep covers three trophies at once.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: every area stays visitable in free roam.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own operations around Leonida, so this is a tour of the underworld: find each gang's turf, hit its operation, and move on to the next. Keep a list of which gangs you have done so you do not repeat one.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: gang operations stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail at a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach and enjoy the view. The description names the place, not the bar: work along the Ocean Beach front until you find a venue that serves cocktails with a sea view. PowerPyx (18 Nov) lists this trophy as not yet pinned down, so the exact bar is still unconfirmed — try the beachfront bars first.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Ocean Beach stays accessible in free roam.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle straight out through the glass of a vehicle showroom — the classic GTA exit. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, get up to speed inside, and smash out through the window. PowerPyx (18 Nov) lists this trophy as not yet pinned down, so the exact showroom is still unconfirmed — any large showroom front is worth trying.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: showrooms stay accessible in free roam.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on your game — the description points at completing a bowling session there rather than just walking in. Play a full game; if the trophy does not pop on the first visit, finish the game properly and try another round.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: the bowling alley stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague — a partnership moment that appeals to the masses. It most likely ties to a partner activity in front of a crowd, but PowerPyx (18 Nov) had not pinned this one down, so treat the exact trigger as unconfirmed and keep playing partner content until it pops. We will not guess a location the sources do not give.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: partner content stays available in free roam.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices that shape your Criminal Profile — GTABase reports PSN tracks a count of 500 profile-changing actions for this trophy, though that figure comes from a single source, so treat it as a guide rather than gospel. Play the way the game asks you to choose, and the count builds up over a normal playthrough. One warning from PowerPyx: the Irredeemable profile is permanent, and it makes the police more aggressive, so avoid pushing your profile that far.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: profile choices keep coming in free roam. Avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on your second try at something — the description points at failing once and then getting it right. The natural reading is retrying a failed attempt until it works, whether a challenge, a stunt or a mission objective. PowerPyx (18 Nov) lists this trophy as not yet pinned down, so the exact trigger is still unconfirmed; if it does not pop naturally, retry a failed challenge and succeed on the second attempt.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: retries are always available in free roam.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description reads like a secret event or easter egg somewhere in Leonida. PowerPyx (18 Nov) lists this trophy as not yet pinned down, so the exact event and place are still unconfirmed. Explore odd corners of the map, follow strange markers and pay attention to one-off events; when something weird happens, this is likely the trophy.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: secret events can be found at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat or similar weapon instead of a gun. Pick a slow-moving vehicle, get close to a pedestrian, and swing as you pass. PowerPyx (18 Nov) lists this trophy as not yet pinned down, so the exact weapon or speed may matter — a slow pass with a melee weapon is the safest bet.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: melee drive-bys can be done at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, so the money for this trophy is earned by playing the crime content — bank vaults, armored trucks and shop robberies all feed it. Keep laundering through your contacts as you earn, and the total builds up across the whole playthrough.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Marked Bills keep coming from robberies in free roam.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. The count is cumulative across every shop, so it builds up naturally as you buy weapons, clothes, food and vehicle upgrades. If you are short near the end, buy expensive items you actually want — weapons and vehicle parts are the fastest way to close the gap.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: shops stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are bought with in-game money, so save up as you play and buy each one when you can afford it — they double as storage for the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good. Check the property listings regularly so you do not miss one tucked away in a quieter district.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: garage properties stay buyable in free roam.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, then register each one through the app — the count is registered vehicles, so a car you merely drive does not count until it is in the app. Work through different vehicle types as you discover them for Whip It Good and the two trophies progress together.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: vehicles can be registered at any time in free roam.
trophies.name: On the Spot
